slots.sentence: Total nonfarm payroll employment changed little in July (-23,000)

slots.name: unemployment_rate
slots.sentence: Both nonfarm payroll employment (-23,000) and the unemployment rate (4.1 percent) changed little in July, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

slots.name: nonfarm_payroll_revision_may_june
slots.sentence: The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for May was revised down by 66,000, from +129,000 to +63,000, and the change for June was revised down by 37,000, from +57,000 to +20,000. With these revisions, employment in May and June combined is 103,000 lower than previously reported.
